raw_text: ULFA-I just claimed responsibility for blowing up two OIL pipeline valve stations in Tinsukia. This is the Duliajan-Numaligarh corridor, one of the most critical crude oil pipelines in the northeast. Reports say 12 hectares of wetland affected by the spill. This is a major escalation in militant activity in upper Assam.
clean_text: ULFA-I claims pipeline attack in Tinsukia on critical Duliajan-Numaligarh corridor. 12 hectares of wetland affected. Major escalation in upper Assam militant activity.
